capabilities: Sync vault files bidirectionally over WebDAV
Resolve conflicts with smart merge or newest/local/remote/skip strategies
Run sync at startup, on a schedule, or in realtime
Pick a remote directory and track sync progress in the status bar
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README. Warns users to back up the vault and test with a separate remote folder before syncing production data. WebDAV passwords are stored in Obsidian secret storage. Released under AGPL-3.0. Mentions BRAT for installing newer GitHub builds before store review completes.
intentEvidence: This project is based on Obsidian WebDAV Sync and Nutstore Sync
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through your own WebDAV server with three-way comparison, conflict resolution, and optional encryption.
